blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Motorcycle riders wearing slippers, flip-flops, or sandals while traveling on public roads risk fines under Land Transportation Office (LTO) regulations, which require motorists to use appropriate footwear for safer motorcycle operation.
